<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. XI.|ACCORDING TO S. LVKE.|171}}</noinclude>God doe cast out Deuils: surely the kingdom of God is come vpon you. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=21}}† When the strong armed keepeth his court: those things are in peace that he possesseth. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=22}}† But if a stronger then he, come vpon him and ouercome him: he vvil take avvay his vvhole armour vvherein he trusted, and vvil distribute his spoiles. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=23}}† He that is not vvith me, is against me: and he that gathereth not vvith me, scattereth. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=24}}† When the vncleane spirit shal depart out of a man, he vvandereth through places vvithout vvater, seeking rest. And not finding, he saith, I vvil returne into my house vvhence I departed. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=25}}† And when he is come, he findeth it swept vvith a besome, and trimmed. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=26}}† Then he goeth and taketh seuen other spirits vvorse then him self, and entring in they dvvel there. And the c {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''nouissima fiunt''}}∷ last of that man be made vvorse then the first.

{{verse|chapter=11|verse=27}}† b {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpon Assumption eue, and in a Votiue of our Lady betwene Candlemas and Easter, and betwene Pentecost and Aduent.}}And it came to passe: vvhen he said these things, a certaine vvoman lifting vp her voice out of the multitude said to him, {{sup|‖}} Blessed is the vvombe that bare thee, and the pappes that thou didst sucke. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=28}}† But he said, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The said mother of God, in that also was blessed that she was the temporal meanes & minister of the Incarnation, but much more blessed, in that she continued the perpetual keeper of his word. ''Beda. Aug. tract. 19. in Ioan''.}}∷ Yea rather, blessed are they that heare the vvord of God, and keepe it.⊣

{{verse|chapter=11|verse=29}}† And the multitudes running together, he began to say, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 12, 29.''}}* This generation, is a vvicked generation: it asketh a signe, and a signe shal not be giuen it but {{sup|‖}} the signe of Ionas the Prophet. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=30}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ion. 2, 2.''}}* For as Ionas vvas a signe to the Niniuites: so shal the Sonne of man also be to this generation. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=31}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''3 Reg. 10, 1.''}}* The Queene of the South shal rise in the iudgement vvith the men of this generation, and shal condemne them: because she came from the endes of the earth to heare the vvisedom of Salomon. and behold, more then Salomon here. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=32}}† The men of Niniuee shal rise in the iudgement vvith this generation, and shal condemne it, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ion. 3, 5.''}}* because they {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''μετενόησαν''. Marke that the great penance of the Niniuites (Ionae 3) is here expressed by this Greeke vvord. ''See Annot. Mat. 3, 2''.}}∷ did penance at the preaching of Ionas. and behold, more then Ionas here.

{{verse|chapter=11|verse=33}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 5, 15. Mar. 4, 21.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel for a Confessor that is Bishop.}}No man lighteth a candel, and putteth it in secrete, neither vnder a bushel: but vpon a candlesticke, that they that goe in may see the light. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=34}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''d Mt. 6, 22.''}}* The candel of thy body, is thine eie. If thine eie be simple, thy vvhole body shal be lightsome: but if it be naught, thy body also shal be darkesome. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=35}}† See therfore that the light vvhich is in thee, be not darkenesse. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=36}}† If then thy vvhole body be lightsome, hauing no part of darkenesse: it shal be lightsome vvholy, and as a bright candel it shal lighten thee.⊣<noinclude>{{rh||Y ij|And}}</noinclude>
